Definition: properly, to project laterally, i.e. probably (reflexive) to withdraw
BiblicalUsage: Kanaph is to withdraw to the side — here, the teachers who will no longer hide in a corner. Though the LORD give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the promise is plain: after affliction, the teachers come out of the corner, and the eyes of the people see them again.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
